## Overview

**Ragnulf Skallfang** — the barbarian chieftain of the Skallfang Clan during the era of the First Alliance. Already known as one of the deadliest monster hunters on the continent, he was selected as one of the seven Alliance heroes entrusted with defeating Khar'Zul. He is an ancestor of Hrothgar Skallfang and part of the lineage that leads to Balor's adoptive family.

---

## Role in the Alliance

Ragnulf brought the Skallfang Clan's generations of monster-hunting expertise to the Alliance's campaign. His knowledge of how to track, fight, and survive against creatures like Khar'Zul proved invaluable. In the first battle, the monster hunters of the Skallfang knew how to fight creatures like Khar'Zul in ways that the other heroes could not.

---

## Fate

Ragnulf survived both battles against Khar'Zul and participated in the sealing ritual. He returned to the Skallfang Clan and continued the monster-hunting tradition that defined his people. His legacy passed down through the generations to Hrothgar Skallfang and, through adoption, to Balor.
